title: Illuminati poster in the Dupont Circle hotel room during National Archives research

tellings.quote: bring my suitcase in and I look up on the wall and somebody had left this huge poster of, you know, the the the eye in the in the pyramid,

plain: Peter Levenda, an author and researcher described as a historian of the CIA, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about a trip to Washington, DC, in the 1970s to research in the National Archives, where the US government keeps its historical records. He says that when he carried his suitcase into his hotel room near Dupont Circle, someone had left a huge poster on the wall of the eye in the pyramid, a symbol often tied to the Illuminati, a secret society of legend. He tells it as one of a string of strange coincidences around that trip, as if someone were watching or sending him a message.
